title: Rescue Outcome Notice
description: What the director tells the user when a Rescue Agent's work on a promoted task ends, success or failure. Pairs with promotion-notice.schema.json — every promotion gets a matching outcome notice. See RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md.

director_verification.description: What the director itself independently checked (diff, re-run tests) per REVIEW-GATES.md — not a restatement of the Rescue Agent's own report.

integrated.description: Whether the change was merged/integrated. Only true if result is success and director_verification passed.

reverted_to_baseline.description: Whether subsequent, unrelated tasks have returned to the normal implementer tier (the promotion was task-scoped and has now ended).

next_step_if_failed.description: Required when result is failure — the RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md Step 3 choice the director is making next.
